SELECT tm.id, tm.tenant_id, tm.shop_id, tm.user_id, tm.member_type, tm.status, tm.joined_at, u.username, u.nickname FROM tenant_member tm LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = tm.user_id
ORDER BY tm.joined_at DESC, tm.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT DISTINCT tm.user_id FROM tenant_member tm WHERE tm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL
